title: Hanasato Minori — Nom Nom Time!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: At The End of The Unraveled Thread

rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, this is it!
MORE MORE JUMP! is appearing on TV for the very first time. Let's get ourselves focused and ready!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem awfully excited, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's because I am.
My phone's also fully charged and ready to go.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, what does your phone have to do with this?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I need to do my best to convey just how amazing MORE MORE JUMP! is to everyone...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, since we've been given an opportunity to appear on TV alongside Cheerful * Days, I'd like to make the most of it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have to make up for what happened back then...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (For Shizuku's sake, I need to do well today...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Minori...?
Are you feeling a bit nervous?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
N-No, I'm fine!
Minori Hanasato's all set to make today's shoot a weally good one!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We get how you feel, but you're tensing up way too much...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's understandable. After all, it is her first time appearing on TV.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's good that you're eager to succeed, Minori, but the facial expression you're making is a little scary.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So, just try to relax. Then, smile.
Why don't we do it together?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That was a nice idea, Haruka.
Green Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! This is our green room...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I should take a picture of the sign out front that said, “Guest: MORE MORE JUMP!” later too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, all these yummy-looking snacks...!
A-Are these really for us...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, they are. This tea also seems to be for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! The green rooms at TV stations are way more amazing than I originally imagined!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori...
You were a nervous wreck just a second ago...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But I understand how she feels.
I was also a bit awestruck when I was given my first green room.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If this shoot goes well, we may be given more opportunities to appear on TV and enjoy these sorts of green rooms.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That's right. We might get the chance to appear on TV more and do other stuff as idols...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Just like Haruka when I was watching her...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sorry, Minori...
I know I'm putting a lot of pressure on you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, um...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I agree with you, Haruka.
I hope we get the chance to do more and more stuff as idols moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same. And I like your thinking.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Minori...
I'm gonna ask a huge favor of you right now. Would you mind listening?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Of course!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: First, curl your hands into little “C” shapes and put your thumbs together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Um... Like this?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, perfect!
Now stick your hands out in front of your chest!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
Wait a second... Isn't this...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ah, it looks like you've figured it out! Then, I'm guessing you know what to do next... One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line: Lovely! Fairy! Momoi.... Airi!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, Airi!
I got to do your self-intro together!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, that's when you're supposed to say, “Why'd you just make me do that?!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In any case, remember what Haruka said before we came here? How important it is to smile?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. Right.
Thanks, Airi.
And I'm sorry for making you worry, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. No problem.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, why don't we have some tea and snacks now?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: These chocolate cookies are particularly delicious, Minori. We always looked forward to having some whenever we were asked to appear on TV.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Are they really that good...?!
Then, I might just have to give them a try.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As for the tea... They've even provided us some honey. Shall I put some in your tea for you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, isn't that what you usually had when you were with ASRUN? Yes, I'd love to have some!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, it's almost time.
Everyone ready?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori...
You have some cookie crumbs on your cheek.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Staff's Voice
rows.Line:
MORE MORE JUMP!
You're on standby!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Understood!
Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I'm a little nervous...
But I feel a lot better now thanks to the others.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We've come this far, so I need to do my best during today's shoot...!)
